title: VPC metrics & log bridge Terraform module for Prometheus, Grafana, and OTEL collector
creator: Asha Menon
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions a "metrics & log bridge" in customer VPCs: managed Prometheus remote-write receiver (or Thanos gateway), Grafana deployment + dashboards, an OpenTelemetry Collector configured for log and metric forwarding, and a log shipper (Fluent Bit) setup. The module must support safe in-place upgrades with pre-flight health probes and a canary upgrade path. This is intended for Redwood Private deployments to standardize observability deployment across customer VPCs and simplify upgrades and incident remediation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Module exposes inputs for naming, CIDR allow-lists, and retention/replication settings; 2) Creates Prometheus receiver resources (remote_write gateway) plus ServiceMonitor CRD hooks where applicable; 3) Deploys OTEL collector with pipeline templates for metrics and logs (splitting to remote_write & log-forwarder) and supports runtime reconfiguration via ConfigMap; 4) Fluent Bit (or equivalent) DaemonSet config for shipping application logs to the collector with node-local buffering; 5) Health check hooks: pre-upgrade readiness probes, post-upgrade smoke tests (query sample metric and check dashboard panel), and an automated rollback trigger if smoke-tests fail; 6) Canary flag to apply changes to N% of nodes/namespace first; 7) Terraform lifecycle/retry configuration and clear upgrade docs; 8) Module includes unit test plan (terraform validate, fmt, tflint) and an integration harness (smoke Terraform apply in CI against ephemeral cluster); 9) Security: all secrets stored in KMS-backed secrets and least-privilege IAM policies generated by module; 10) Documentation: module README with configuration examples and troubleshooting steps.
implementation_notes:
- Use separate sub-modules for prometheus_gateway, grafana_deployment, otel_collector, and log_shipper to keep surface area small.
- Prefer Kubernetes operator CRs (Prometheus Operator) when present; fallback to plain StatefulSet + Service if operator not available.
- Use Terraform null_resource + local-exec for coordinated upgrade steps (drain, patch, smoke-test, uncordon). Keep these idempotent.
- Implement canary via label selector and nodeAffinity so changes apply first to labelled nodes/namespaces.
- Provide `preflight_checks` boolean and `smoke_test_query` input so customers can opt-in to automated validation.
- Design for cheap rollbacks: keep previous config as `config_backup` in a ConfigMap secret and expose a `rollback` toggle that the ops CLI can flip.
- Ensure metrics ingestion has circuit breaker: if remote write fails >X attempts then fallback to local TSDB retention increase and alert.
- Avoid hard-coding image tags; provide image mapping variable with default pins per release.
- Include example dashboards as JSON files in module and helper script to load into Grafana via API in a controlled job.
- Tests: terraform plan diff must surface any destructive changes to Service/Endpoints or PVs; fail pipeline if detected without explicit `force=true`.
